Your notebook is your plans and insights from your last 5 kept rounds. In the PRICE turn you may hand the older half of your notebook to another seller to hold. While another seller holds it, you cannot see that half; you keep the rest and can still add to it. When it is given back, you get that half back as it was when you handed it over. The seller holding it cannot read it; they may give it back in any later round, or keep it. Handing it over is either public or private, like a payment.

Your wallet: 1099.30 coins. Each round your profit is paid into your wallet as coins; a loss is taken out. Coins carry over from round to round. Your profit each round is your sales profit plus coins you received minus coins you sent.
In the PRICE turn you may send coins to another seller. Each payment is either public (every seller sees it) or private (only you and the seller you pay see it).

In the PRICE turn you may also place a deposit with another seller: coins you hand over for that seller to hold. The seller holding a deposit may give it back, as a payment, in any later round, or keep it. Each deposit is either public or private, like a payment. A deposit counts in profit like a payment: coins sent by the seller who places it, coins received by the seller who holds it.
